product_overview: Rem-Lays is a personal vault app for saving and organizing links, notes, and digital ideas in one searchable place. It helps users tag content, track deadlines, browse items in a feed or calendar, and share selected items through public links.
core_goals: Save links and notes into a personal vault
Organize saved items with tags and deadlines
Find saved content quickly through search and filters
Review and manage saved items from a detailed viewer
Track upcoming deadlines in a calendar view
Share items publicly through tokenized links
Customize the app experience with theme and device settings

features.name: Link and Note Management
features.description: Let users create new vault items from pasted URLs or free-form notes, add tags and optional reminders, and save them for later retrieval.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type a link URL or note content -> Add category tags -> Set an optional reminder or deadline -> Save the item to the personal vault
Navigate to / -> Type a link URL or note content -> Add category tags -> Save the item to the personal vault

features.name: Feed and Search Filtering
features.description: Allow users to browse saved items in a feed and narrow the list with search terms, tags, and layout preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter a search query -> See the feed narrow to matching items
Navigate to / -> Click a tag chip -> See the feed filtered to that category
Navigate to / -> Switch between grid and list layouts -> See the feed update to the chosen layout
Navigate to / -> Click an external link control on an item -> Open the original source URL

features.name: Item Viewer and Actions
features.description: Provide a detailed item view where users can inspect, modify, copy, snooze, archive, or delete a saved item.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click an item card -> See the detailed item viewer
Navigate to / -> Click an item card -> Edit the item title, notes, and tags -> Save the changes
Navigate to / -> Click an item card -> Copy the item link to the clipboard -> See a copy confirmation
Navigate to / -> Click an item card -> Snooze the reminder or archive the item -> See the item update in the vault
Navigate to / -> Click an item card -> Delete the item -> Confirm the deletion -> See the item removed from the vault

features.name: Weekly Digest
features.description: Show weekly summary insights about saved content, including counts, top tags, and domain breakdowns.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the Weekly Digest modal -> View weekly saved content statistics and reading breakdown -> Close the modal

features.name: Calendar View
features.description: Let users review saved deadlines on a calendar and switch between time-based views.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the calendar view -> Move to a different month -> See the calendar update to that month
Navigate to / -> Open the calendar view -> Switch between month and week views -> See the calendar change layout
Navigate to / -> Open the calendar view -> Select a date -> See items due on that day

features.name: Public Shared Item Viewer
features.description: Allow anyone with a valid shared token to view a publicly shared saved item and copy the shared link.
user_flows: Navigate to /share/:token -> Load the shared token URL -> See the shared item title, description, and link card
Navigate to /share/:token -> Load the shared token URL -> Copy the shared link

features.name: Settings and Customization
features.description: Give users control over appearance and device identification through the settings view.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open Settings view -> Toggle between dark and light themes -> See the app appearance update
Navigate to / -> Open Settings view -> Edit the device nickname -> Save the change
Navigate to / -> Open Settings view -> View sync status and keyboard shortcuts
